lines.en: label mollydorm5:
I knock on Molly’s door and wait to see if she responds.
lines.zh: 我敲了敲 Molly 的门，等着看她会不会回应。

lines.en: Honestly, I’m not even sure if she’ll be around today...but it’s worth a shot I guess...
lines.zh: 说实话，我都不确定她今天在不在……不过值得一试吧，我想……

lines.en: I know she works night shifts at the cafe, and it’s not like there’s really any reason for someone other than her or Tsuneyo to come up here for the time being...
lines.zh: 我知道她在咖啡厅上夜班，再说眼下除了她和 Tsuneyo，也没什么理由会有别人上这儿来……

lines.en: But hey, maybe I’ll luck out and she’ll be the leader of some cool lesbian orgy club or something.
lines.zh: 不过嘛，说不定我运气好，她会是什么超酷的女同性恋狂欢俱乐部之类的头目。

lines.en: That would be neat.
lines.zh: 那还挺带劲的。

lines.en: : Who goes there?!
lines.zh: : 来者何人？！

lines.en: : Have you come to vanquish me?!
lines.zh: : 你是来讨伐我的吗？！

lines.en: : Prepare yourself, mortal! For I, Molly MacCormack-
lines.zh: : 受死吧，凡人！因为我，Molly MacCormack——

lines.en: : Molly, it’s me. I’m not here to vanquish you.
lines.zh: : Molly，是我。我不是来讨伐你的。

lines.en: : That...That voice...
lines.zh: : 这……这个声音……

lines.en: : Could it be?...
lines.zh: : 难道说？……

lines.en: : ...Could it be what?
lines.zh: : ……难道说什么？

lines.en: : Come in...
lines.zh: : 进来吧……

lines.en: : The preparations have already been made.
lines.zh: : 准备已经做好了。

lines.en: scene black
...What preparations?
lines.zh: ……什么准备？

lines.en: I sigh to myself and push open the door to Molly’s room.
lines.zh: 我暗自叹了口气，推开了 Molly 的房门。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm1
if tsuneyodorm5 == True:
I step into Molly’s room and take in the scenery yet again.
lines.zh: 我走进 Molly 的房间，又一次打量起这里的景致。

lines.en: I hadn’t really paid much attention to Molly’s side of the room when I came to visit Tsuneyo, but now that I’m actually observing it, it seems...
lines.zh: 之前来找 Tsuneyo 的时候，我其实没怎么留意 Molly 这一半的房间，可现在认真一看，它显得……

lines.en: Expensive.
lines.zh: 很贵。

lines.en: else:
I step into Molly’s room and am greeted by, more or less, exactly what I expected to see.
lines.zh: 我走进 Molly 的房间，迎面而来的，基本就是我预料中会看到的东西。

lines.en: Her side of the dorm is equipped with a bunch of anime memorabilia, a nice looking computer, and several weird looking chairs.
lines.zh: 她那一半宿舍摆着一堆动画周边、一台看起来很不错的电脑，还有几张造型古怪的椅子。

lines.en: While Tsuneyo’s side is...
lines.zh: 而 Tsuneyo 那一半呢……

lines.en: Well, it has noodles.
lines.zh: 嗯，有泡面。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm2
: Hello and welcome to Casa Del Molly! Otherwise known as the “Sanctuary!”
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到 Casa Del Molly！也就是所谓的「圣域」！

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure this is just Dorm #6.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这顶多就是六号宿舍吧。

lines.en: : Tomato, tomato.
lines.zh: : 差不多啦。

lines.en: : That phrase really doesn’t have the same impact when it’s spelled out.
lines.zh: : 这句话写出来可就没那个效果了。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm3
: Whatcha up to, Sir? I’m assuming you’re here for a reason, right?
lines.zh: : 您在忙什么呢，老师？我猜您来是有事的对吧？

lines.en: : It’s not like a teacher would just visit a [young_girl]’s dorm room just to hang out.
lines.zh: : 老师总不会只是为了找人消磨时间，就跑来一个 [young_girl] 的宿舍房间吧。

lines.en: : Actually, Molly. I think there’s something you might have to learn about me.
lines.zh: : 其实啊，Molly。我觉得有件事你可能得了解一下我。

lines.en: : I sort of do this with everyone. Just...show up at their room and get them to kill time with me, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我差不多对谁都这样。就是……跑到她们房间，让她们陪我打发时间，我是说。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm4
: You’re allowed to do that? There aren’t like, rules against guys in girls’ dorms and stuff?
lines.zh: : 这样也行？就没有什么规定禁止男生进女生宿舍之类的？

lines.en: : If there are, I’ve broken them probably several hundred times by now.
lines.zh: : 就算有，我大概也已经违反了好几百次了。

lines.en: : Wack.
lines.zh: : 离谱。

lines.en: : You don’t have a problem with it, do you? I know we haven’t really spent much time together but-
lines.zh: : 你不介意对吧？我知道我们其实没怎么单独相处过，不过——

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm5
: Of course I don’t have a problem with it! If anything, this is an excellent development! A great chance to prove my worth!
lines.zh: : 我当然不介意！要说的话，这可是个绝佳的进展！是证明我价值的大好机会！

lines.en: : Tell me, Sir. Do you like scantily dressed women? Some even stripped down to their underwear?
lines.zh: : 老师，请告诉我。您喜欢穿着暴露的女性吗？有些甚至只剩内衣的那种？

lines.en: : Is this a trick question? Because I feel like this is a trick question.
lines.zh: : 这是陷阱题吗？我怎么觉得这是陷阱题。

lines.en: : No tricks here, Sir. Just degeneracy.
lines.zh: : 这里没有陷阱，老师。只有废柴爱好。

lines.en: : As it just so happens, I have quite the collection of anime figures, and several of them are wearing next to nothing!
lines.zh: : 巧了，我收藏了相当多的动画手办，其中好几个身上几乎什么都没穿！

lines.en: : Oh, those. Yeah I can see those from here. I’m not really into that, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 哦，那些啊。对，我在这儿都能看见。说实话我对那个真没什么兴趣。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm6
: Whaaaaat? Not even a little? But I spent so much money on them.
lines.zh: : 啥————？一点都没有？我可是在它们身上花了大价钱的。

lines.en: : Who spends that much money on plastic anime girls?
lines.zh: : 谁会花那么多钱买塑料动画少女啊？

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm2
: I do. And I regret nothing.
lines.zh: : 我啊。而且我一点都不后悔。

lines.en: : In fact, I’m prepared to spend every penny I earn for the rest of my life on fueling my hobby.
lines.zh: : 事实上，我已经准备好把后半辈子赚的每一分钱都砸在这个爱好上。

lines.en: : You should probably put together a steady source of income first.
lines.zh: : 你大概得先有个稳定的收入来源才行。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine your part time barista gig will be enough to fuel a hobby as expensive as that.
lines.zh: : 我实在想象不出你那份兼职咖啡师的工作，够养活这么烧钱的爱好。

lines.en: : I’ll figure out a way to make it work. I won’t have time for games and stuff if I get a full-time job.
lines.zh: : 我总会想到办法的。要是找了份全职工作，我就没时间打游戏什么的了。

lines.en: : Well, just keep in mind that you’ll only be able to live in the dorm for another couple years.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过你要记住，你还能在宿舍住的时间也就剩几年了。

lines.en: : After that, it’s either find work or get used to living on the streets.
lines.zh: : 之后要么找工作，要么就习惯睡大街吧。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t fare well on the streets. I’ve only known Japanese for a couple years.
lines.zh: : 我在大街上可活不下去。我才学了几年的日语。

lines.en: : Wait, really? You have a bit of an accent, but your pronunciation is spot-on.
lines.zh: : 等等，真的吗？你是有点口音，但发音相当标准啊。

lines.en: : Never underestimate the power of learning through anime, Sir.
lines.zh: : 老师，千万别小看通过动画学习的力量。

lines.en: : Combine that with language exchange chat rooms and you have one happy, informed weeb, Sir.
lines.zh: : 再加上语言交换聊天室，就有了您眼前这个快乐又博学的 weeb，老师。

lines.en: : Molly, can you please explain to me what a weeb is? I suddenly feel the need to be informed.
lines.zh: : Molly，你能给我解释一下什么是 weeb 吗？我突然觉得有必要了解一下。

lines.en: : Are you sure, Sir? What if some plebeian complains about it in the comment section?
lines.zh: : 您确定吗，老师？万一有什么平民百姓在评论区抱怨呢？

lines.en: : What comment section?
lines.zh: : 什么评论区？

lines.en: : No idea, Sir. But here is your daily weebnote!
lines.zh: : 不知道啊，老师。不过这是您今天的 weebnote！

lines.en: : Weebnote: A weeb is any non-Japanese person who becomes obsessed with anime and Japanese culture to the point where it becomes almost cringeworthy.
lines.zh: : Weebnote：weeb 指的是任何非日本人，却对动画和日本文化痴迷到几乎令人尴尬的程度的人。

lines.en: : So like, a foreign otaku?
lines.zh: : 所以就是，外国的御宅族？

lines.en: : Precisely.
lines.zh: : 正是。

lines.en: : I don’t really see a problem with that. People like what they like.
lines.zh: : 我看这也没什么问题啊。人各有所好嘛。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm7
: If only everyone else looked at things that way.
lines.zh: : 要是别人都能这么想就好了。

lines.en: : I can’t even cosplay at conventions in Japan without people lookin’ at me all weird and stuff.
lines.zh: : 我连在日本的漫展上出 cosplay，都会被人用奇怪的眼神看着。

lines.en: : I’m lucky enough that the manga club accepts me, but even that I kinda had to beat my way into.
lines.zh: : 漫画社肯收留我已经算走运了，而且那还是我硬闯进去的。

lines.en: : Oh come on. That can’t be true. Ami and Rin are in that club and they’re accepting of pretty much everyone.
lines.zh: : 得了吧。不可能。Ami 和 Rin 也在那个社里，她们基本上对谁都来者不拒啊。

lines.en: : That’s true. But even then it’s like, I can’t help but feel like they looked at me a little weird at first.
lines.zh: : 这倒是。可即便如此，我就是忍不住觉得，她们一开始看我的眼神也有点怪。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm2
: But hey! They’re two of my best pals ever now and I couldn’t be happier to be livin’ out my dreams in the land of the rising sun!
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来！她们现在是我最好的两个朋友了，能在日出之国实现自己的梦想，我再幸福不过了！

lines.en: Interesting.
lines.zh: 有意思。

lines.en: I guess Molly’s just seemed so...overly-confident so far that it never really occurred to me that there was a time where she felt out of place.
lines.zh: 我想，Molly 一直以来表现得那么……自信过头，我压根没想到她也有过格格不入的时候。

lines.en: But I can absolutely understand why.
lines.zh: 但我完全能理解为什么。

lines.en: It must be hard looking different than everyone else. Especially in a place as closed off as Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: 长得跟别人不一样一定很难受。尤其是在 Kumon-mi 这种封闭的地方。

lines.en: if ayanedorm15 == True:
In fact, I remember Ayane telling me something a while back about how outsiders aren’t really as accepted here as they probably should be.
lines.zh: 事实上，我记得 Ayane 之前跟我说过，这里对外来者的接纳程度远没有应该有的那么高。

lines.en: And even then, she was talking about Japanese outsiders from different prefectures.
lines.zh: 而她当时说的，还只是来自其他县的日本外地人。

lines.en: I can only imagine what it’s like for someone from a completely different country.
lines.zh: 我真不敢想象，一个来自完全不同国家的人会是什么感受。

lines.en: else:
But I guess foreigners are bound to be looked at strangely no matter where they are. That’s just human nature, unfortunately.
lines.zh: 不过我想，外国人不管走到哪儿，大概都会被人用奇怪的眼光看。不幸的是，这就是人性。

lines.en: : Well, uhh, anyway! How do {i}you{/i} feel about cosplay, Sir?
lines.zh: : 嗯，呃，总之！老师，{i}您{/i}对 cosplay 有什么看法？

lines.en: : Are you one of those people who thinks it’s embarrassing? Or are you one of those people who thinks it’s the greatest thing ever?
lines.zh: : 您是那种觉得它很丢人的人？还是那种觉得它是天底下最棒的东西的人？

lines.en: : Is there no middle ground?
lines.zh: : 就没有中间地带吗？

lines.en: : There is not.
lines.zh: : 没有。

lines.en: : Oh. Well it wouldn’t matter anyway because I’d definitely choose option two.
lines.zh: : 哦。那也无所谓，因为我肯定会选第二种。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm4
: Really? Even though you don’t like anime and stuff?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？就算您不喜欢动画什么的？

lines.en: : You don’t need to like anime to appreciate girls in cute costumes. And I very much appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 欣赏穿着可爱服装的女生，不需要喜欢动画。而我非常欣赏。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm2
: Then perhaps you can still be saved after all...
lines.zh: : 那看来您还是有救的……

lines.en: : For you see...I, Molly MacCormack, am a self-proclaimed master-cosplayer!
lines.zh: : 因为您看……我，Molly MacCormack，是自封的 cosplay 大师！

lines.en: : Adding “self-proclaimed” to the title really takes away from how impressive it is, but I can’t say I’m not intrigued.
lines.zh: : 加上「自封」两个字，可就大大削弱了它的厉害程度，不过我得说我确实被勾起了兴趣。

lines.en: : Would you like to see a little sample?
lines.zh: : 您想看一小段吗？

lines.en: Fuck yes I would. But it’s not like I can just come out and say-
lines.zh: 我他妈当然想。不过我总不能直接说——

lines.en: : Fuck yes I would.
lines.zh: : 我他妈当然想。

lines.en: Damnit.
lines.zh: 该死。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm9
: Excellent...{i}Excellent{/i}.
lines.zh: : 很好……{i}很好{/i}。

lines.en: : Then...If you would be so kind as to follow me to the bed...We can get started.
lines.zh: : 那么……如果您愿意赏光跟我到床边来……我们就可以开始了。

lines.en: : Yes please.
lines.zh: : 好的，请。

lines.en: scene black
Molly shyly turns around and hops onto her bed.
lines.zh: Molly 害羞地转过身，跳上了她的床。

lines.en: I follow quickly behind her and she-
lines.zh: 我赶紧跟在她后面，然后她——

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm10
: {i}Darkness blacker than black...darker than dark...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}比黑更黑暗……比暗更幽深……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I beseech thee...combine with my deep crimson.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我在此祈求……与我深红之血融合。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}The time of awakening cometh!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}觉醒的时刻已经到来！{/i}

lines.en: : Uhh...
scene firstmollydorm11
: {i}Justice fallen upon the infallible boundary...{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}降临于绝对境界之上的正义……{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Appear now as an intangible distortion!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}以无形的扭曲之姿，现身吧！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I desire for my torrent of power...a destructive force!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我渴望那奔涌的力量……毁灭之力！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}A destructive force without equal!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}无可匹敌的毁灭之力！{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Return all creation to cinders and come out from the abyss!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}将一切造化归于灰烬，自深渊中现身吧！{/i}

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm12
: {i}EXPLOOOOOOOO...SION!{/i}
scene black
Molly drops her staff and hops off of the bed, skipping over to her computer desk.
lines.zh: Molly 放下法杖，跳下床，蹦蹦跳跳地跑到她的电脑桌前。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm13
: So? Whaddya think? Pretty cool, right?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？您觉得如何？挺酷的吧？

lines.en: : I mean...it was a cool monologue. But I don’t really know if I would count just a staff as cosplay.
lines.zh: : 我是说……那段独白挺酷的。但只有一根法杖，我不太确定能不能算 cosplay。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm14
: That’s where you’re wrong, Sir. A good cosplayer must not only wear the costume, but embody the personality of the character as well.
lines.zh: : 老师，这您就错了。一个好的 coser 不光要穿上服装，还要把角色的性格也演出来。

lines.en: : Okay, sure. But there was no costume at all.
lines.zh: : 行吧，算是。可你根本没穿 costume 啊。

lines.en: : The costume is in my wardrobe.
lines.zh: : costume 在我衣柜里。

lines.en: : Are you going to put it on?
lines.zh: : 你要穿上吗？

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm15
: R-Right now?...With you just...standing there watching me?
lines.zh: : 现……现在？……你就……站在那儿看着我？

lines.en: : I know that you’re my master, but this is...
lines.zh: : 我知道您是我的主人，可是这也……

lines.en: : Actually, on second thought, don’t worry about it. I’m sure I’ll see it eventually and I imagine that speech took a lot out of you.
lines.zh: : 其实，再想想，算了。我肯定迟早会看到的，而且我猜刚才那段独白也挺费你力气的。

lines.en: scene firstmollydorm14
: I’ve practiced it like two-hundred times. In fact, Tsuneyo probably even knows it now from how much I’ve been doing it lately.
lines.zh: : 我练了大概两百遍呢。事实上，我最近念得太频繁，Tsuneyo 大概都会背了。

lines.en: : I...would very much like to see her attempt to do what you just did.
lines.zh: : 我……非常想看她试着来一遍你刚才那套。

lines.en: : We will convince her together.
lines.zh: : 那我们就一起说服她。

lines.en: : She’s gorgeous so I wanna see her get dressed up too.
lines.zh: : 她那么漂亮，我也想看她打扮起来。

lines.en: : And Ami.
lines.zh: : 还有 Ami。

lines.en: : My Ami?
lines.zh: : 我的 Ami？

lines.en: : Your Ami. She’s been wanting to cosplay for a while and we’re close to the same size, so I’m gonna let her try on some of my stuff.
lines.zh: : 你的 Ami。她想玩 cosplay 已经有一阵子了，而且我们身材差不多，所以我打算让她试试我的几件衣服。

lines.en: : Please, for the love of god, show me when you do.
lines.zh: : 拜托，看在老天爷的份上，到时候一定要给我看。

lines.en: : I will have her send pictures.
lines.zh: : 我会让她发照片的。

lines.en: : Thanks Molly. I had no idea you were such a great-
lines.zh: : 谢了，Molly。我真不知道你居然是这么一个了不得的——

lines.en: : 500 Yen each.
lines.zh: : 每张 500 日元。

lines.en: : ...Salesman.
lines.zh: : ……推销员。

lines.en: : I learned from a wise man that I must start making more money as soon as possible or I will be forced to live on the streets.
lines.zh: : 一位智者教会我，我必须尽快开始赚更多的钱，否则就会被逼去睡大街。

lines.en: : 500 Yen each?
lines.zh: : 每张 500 日元？

lines.en: : 500 Yen each.
lines.zh: : 每张 500 日元。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: scene black
Molly and I shake hands and I feel like I’ve just agreed to doing something very suspicious.
lines.zh: 我和 Molly 握了手，感觉自己刚刚答应了什么非常可疑的事。

lines.en: But hey, suspicious is pretty much my middle name at this point.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，「可疑」到这会儿差不多已经是我的中间名了。

lines.en: And if the only thing separating me from seeing a bunch of cute girls in costumes is some pocket change, so be it...
lines.zh: 而如果挡在我和一堆穿 costumes 的可爱女生之间的，只是几个零钱，那就这样吧……

lines.en: I would have probably even paid more if she asked.
lines.zh: 她要是多要一点，我大概也会付。

lines.en: $ molly_love += 1
$ mollydorm5 = True
{i}Molly’s affection has increased to [molly_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Molly 的好感度提升到了 [molly_love]!{/i}
